svg.title: Live SDR receiver layout
svg.text: OpenWebRX / OpenWebRX+ [W1,W3] · KiwiSDR [W7] · WebSDR [W26] · fldigi [W15] · SDRangel [W19]
and this is what you hear (F3)
Horizontal drag on the raster tunes FREQUENCY — never time [W3, W26]. No transport, no seek, no rate: a live
receiver has no future to seek into. Those absences are medium facts, not conventions to copy.
Colour is baked into the canvas at draw time, so a slider move cannot repaint history [W3] — H4 ✗.
